projectName.description: Project display name, used only as a context hint.

commands.description: Known project commands injected into the prompt. commands.test/build/lint are also used for Docker sandbox detection, and commands.test is used by aicode test.

protectedPaths.description: Additional protected-path globs. Built-in .env, SSH/GPG/cloud credential, and private-key rules always apply and cannot be removed by repository configuration. Project Trust is also external to repository configuration.

execution.description: Project-level overrides for where Agent-issued commands run.

agentBashBackend.description: Where the Agent's bash tool runs. 'auto' (default) keeps trusted workspaces on the host and sandboxes untrusted ones; 'host' always runs on the host; 'docker' always sandboxes in a container; 'os' always sandboxes with the platform sandbox (macOS seatbelt), which starts in milliseconds and needs no image but is a weaker boundary than a container. Omit to inherit the Runtime-wide AICODE_AGENT_BASH_BACKEND setting.

mcp.description: External tool servers spoken to over the Model Context Protocol.

name.description: Namespace for this server's tools; they are exposed as mcp__<name>__<tool>.

command.description: argv used to launch the server; it speaks MCP over stdio.

envAllowlist.description: Extra environment variables the server may inherit, on top of the minimal default set. Provider keys and the Runtime token are never passed.

hooks.description: Commands run around tool events. 'post_edit' runs after an edit lands (format what was written) and cannot veto it; 'pre_bash' runs before a shell command and refuses it on a non-zero exit, which is how a lint gate before commit works. Hook commands go through the same execution, policy and audit path as Agent commands, and are ignored entirely in an untrusted workspace because a hook is code chosen by whoever wrote the repository.

command.description: Shell command. {path} and {command} are substituted shell-quoted.

match.description: Glob against the edited path or the shell command; omit to match everything.

blocking.description: pre_bash only: refuse the command when the hook fails. Default true.
